title: She skipped one check
logline: Maya's deploy fails again; Sam shows her the one check she skipped.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Maya has shipped this fix three times today.

lines.action: Maya turns to look at him.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The check takes a whole minute.

lines.action: Maya runs the check. It fails on line one.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Oh. It was the config all along.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One minute of checking saved her the afternoon.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Run the check first. Then ship.

narration: Maya has shipped this fix three times today. Third time. Same red build. Did you run the check? The check takes a whole minute. The deploy takes ten. Oh. It was the config all along. One minute of checking saved her the afternoon. Run the check first. Then ship.
